other_additions_breakdown.label: Gain on disposal group classified as held for sale

quotes.income_for_year: Gain on disposal group classified as held for sale | (4,081) - printed as a negative deduction inside the pre-subtotal adjustment stack (Note 25)
quotes.subtotal: Income available for distribution | 118,853 (before 10% retention of 11,885, which yields Income to be distributed 106,968)

note: As flagged: the held-for-sale gain is a NEGATIVE line here - it is a non-cash accounting gain already inside 'Ordinary profit before tax' that is being STRIPPED OUT of distributable income (not an extra amount being distributed on top). Classified as non-operating (divestment/disposal gain) per the spec's category list, so it is moved to other_additions carrying its printed negative sign: other_additions = -4,081. income_for_year is therefore the printed subtotal (118,853) minus this negative other_additions, i.e. 118,853 - (-4,081) = 122,934, so that income_for_year + other_additions reconciles back to 118,853. The 10% retention (11,885) is out of scope per trap 4.
